axis_report: Assigned Spec slice only: criteria 1–6 pass source inspection. The ticket header precedes the history pane. Receipt totals come from validated phase receipts after identity and parent-graph checks. Invalid fields do not contribute, and graph failures leave totals unavailable. Event rows keep identity, execution, verdict, and source in separate labelled fields. Completed review FAILURE and execution failed remain distinct without colour. Enter opens a dedicated detail pane. Execution and readable body precede extended evidence. The detail includes full source IDs, workspace, branch, session, and raw fields. Wrapping and line/page scrolling preserve access to long evidence. Public modal tests cover these behaviors, including narrow evidence paging. No blocking mismatch was found for the assigned criteria. This is not a whole-ticket verdict and does not authorize integration or ticket completion.
